organizations.notes: dbt reporting layer built from the INT_DEV (internal Origin dev 25.4) CISADM extract -- real C2M-shaped data, no client PII. The fabricated fixtures live in the local 5433 target and ORIGINBA_FIXTURES, not here.

dbt reporting layer built from the Demo 25.4 (PDEMODB_DEMO 23ai) full census -- 4.79M landing rows, the largest C2M-shaped dataset we serve. Its own Supabase project: the two instances share ID space (an ACCT_ID collides) so it cannot share INT_DEV's tables. Cloud copy is capped on three tables (measurements, batch runs, init measurement data) and has MICR_ID, WEB_PASSWD*, ALERT_INFO and EXT_ACCT_ID nulled.

IN-DATABASE shape since 2026-08-28: the dbt canvases live in ORIGINBA_REPORTING inside the Ellensburg 25.4 TEST instance, rebuilt every 6 hours with 120 source-parity checks behind them (originba_dbt nightly). Connection: ELLENSBURG_* env keys. Rollback: engine back to postgres (the validated slice DB) -- nothing else changes.
organizations.data_as_of_note: TEST copy stopped receiving activity: ~11,700 bills a month through May 2026, last normal bill-cycle day 2026-06-18, then 2 bills in August and 1 in September (measured 2026-09-28 on ORIGINBA_REPORTING). Relative windows end here; remove the key when the copy is refreshed.
